title: ID Card
description:
The ID Card stores a player. Right click with it in your hand to bind it to yourself; right clicking again overwrites the stored player. The tooltip shows the player's name.

- Combine an ID Card with an Emerald Compass in a crafting table to make the compass point to that player. The card is not used up.

- Put it in the filter slot of an Entity Detector in custom mode to match only that player. An unbound card matches any player.

- Put it in the whitelist slots of a Global Chat Detector so that consuming chat messages only works for that player.
